items.title: This blockchain just voted to shut itself down for a Solana-powered AI pivot
items.whyYouShouldCare: The decision to shut down the blockchain for an AI pivot could redirect resources and attention towards Solana, potentially enhancing its ecosystem and innovation.

items.title: ZetaChain holders approve plan to wind down L1, move ZETA to Solana
items.whyYouShouldCare: ZetaChain's transition to Solana may increase liquidity and user engagement on the Solana network, bolstering its application ecosystem.

items.title: Jupiter’s 15% rally – Tokenized stocks on Solana fuel JUP’s jump
